entities.summary: The Hanoi University of Science and Technology is the first and largest technical university in Vietnam. In May 2010 its name in English was changed to Hanoi University of Science and Technology, this was made with the goal to promote research and training alongside the university's purpose besides technology transfer. The name in Vietnamese and French remain the same — Đại học Bách khoa Hà Nội and Institut Polytechnique de Hanoi respectively. HUST is a multidisciplinary technical university. Hanoi University of Science and Technology is a university in Asia, established in 1956-10-15. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Established in 1956, Hanoi University of Science and Technology has played a crucial role in Vietnam's technological development and education system, with over 40,000 students graduating annually. Its multidisciplinary approach has contributed to the country's economic growth and modernization.
